data.name: Landing.About.Lead
data.value: The Saudi International Maritime Forum rises to the level of a global event that brings together leaders, decision-makers and officials to exchange experience and expertise and to build a shared global understanding of the future of maritime security amid accelerating geopolitical and technological shifts — reflecting the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia's strategic role in anchoring the stability of the seas and supporting the sustainability of the global economy.

data.name: Landing.Hero2.Lead
data.value: To strengthen an integrated maritime-security system that supports international efforts to protect the seabed and improve the efficiency of energy and trade supply chains — contributing to the stability of the global economy and aligning with the goals of Vision 2030.

data.name: Landing.Themes.Sub
data.value: To shape a comprehensive strategic vision addressing energy, trade and connectivity systems between the surface and the depths — through five key themes that form the pillars of maritime security and global economic stability.

data.name: Visit.Visa.Sub
data.value: Entering Saudi Arabia is easier than ever — here is how to plan your travel and visa for the forum.

data.name: Visit.Visa.Body1
data.value: Getting an entry visa to Saudi Arabia is now easier! eVisas and visas on arrival are available for 66 nationalities, in addition to holders of a valid, previously used US, UK or Schengen visa. Residents of the GCC countries who work in qualifying professions can also apply for an eVisa through their portal.

data.name: Visit.Visa.Body2
data.value: The Saudi authorities have also announced that citizens of any country holding a US, UK or Schengen visa are eligible to apply for a tourist visa. These tourist visas allow Muslims from eligible countries to perform Umrah at any time outside the Hajj season. Muslims of any of the nationalities above may visit Makkah and Madinah on an eVisa. Non-Muslims cannot enter Makkah at any time during their visit to Saudi Arabia.

data.name: Privacy.PageTitle
data.value: Privacy Policy — Saudi International Maritime Forum

data.name: Privacy.Meta
data.value: The Saudi International Maritime Forum privacy policy: how we collect, use and share your personal information when you use our digital services.

data.name: Privacy.Intro.Body
data.value: This privacy policy explains how the Saudi International Maritime Forum ("we", "us" or "our") collects, uses and shares your personal information when you use our services, including when you use any of our digital services.

data.name: Privacy.Collect.Personal.Body
data.value: We collect the information you give us directly, such as your name, your email address and your phone number. From time to time we may ask for additional information in order to process certain services, such as registration.

data.name: Privacy.Collect.Usage.Body
data.value: We collect information about how you use our services, including your Internet Protocol (IP) address, your browser type and your operating system.

data.name: Privacy.Collect.Cookies.Body
data.value: We use cookies and other tracking technologies to improve your experience and to analyse how our services are used.

data.name: Privacy.Use.Services.Body
data.value: We use your information to provide our services and to improve them.

data.name: Privacy.Use.Communication.Body
data.value: We use your information to send you marketing messages, such as important news, updates and the essential information that supports your attendance.

data.name: Privacy.Use.Legal.Body
data.value: We may use your information to comply with our legal obligations.

data.name: Privacy.Disclosure.Body
data.value: We do not sell your personal information to third parties. We may, however, share your information with official third-party service providers who perform services on our behalf, such as research or customer support.

data.name: Privacy.Exhibitors.Body1
data.value: By completing the "Exhibitor participation request" and registering as an exhibitor, you automatically agree to our privacy policy. As an exhibitor at the Saudi International Maritime Forum exhibition, we will disclose your data to a limited number of third parties. Those parties are official contractors engaged by us to deliver essential services to you as the exhibitor.

data.name: Privacy.Exhibitors.Body2
data.value: You have the right to ask us not to disclose your personal data to third parties, but you should be aware that doing so will significantly affect your participation in the exhibition.

data.name: Privacy.Exhibitors.Body3
data.value: If you wish to withdraw from the disclosure of your personal data, please write to us at:

data.name: Privacy.Visitors.Body
data.value: By registering to attend the 4th Saudi International Maritime Forum, you agree that the exhibition organiser may use your data to contact you about important information relating to your registration status, and about exhibition news and developments, in order to help you plan your visit. Once registered, you also agree to your data being shared with a third-party provider (or providers) appointed specifically to gather visitor research, so that suggestions and impressions can help improve the exhibition.

data.name: Privacy.Links.Body
data.value: Our service may contain links to other sites. If you click an external link you will be directed to that site. Please note that we do not operate those sites, so we strongly advise you to review the privacy policy of those websites. We have no control over, and accept no responsibility for, the content, privacy policies or practices of those websites or their services.

data.name: Privacy.Security.Body
data.value: We take appropriate security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorised access, alteration or destruction.

data.name: Privacy.Delete.Body1
data.value: You can delete your Saudi International Maritime Forum app account at any time from inside the app itself: open "My area", choose "Delete account", then confirm.

data.name: Privacy.Delete.Body2
data.value: When an account is deleted we erase the personal data on your profile, destroy your uploaded photos and identity document, revoke every session and registered device, and permanently disable the account. The action cannot be undone. We retain only a minimal record of the deletion itself, to meet our legal obligations and for security auditing.

data.name: Privacy.Delete.Body3
data.value: If you cannot reach the app, you can request deletion of your account and data by writing to us at:

data.name: Privacy.Changes.Body
data.value: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes by updating the "Last updated" date shown above in this policy.

data.name: Privacy.Contact.Body
data.value: For further enquiries, contact us by email at:
